identity.name: G-Shock GW-5000U

movement.caliber: Module 3495, Tough Solar quartz with Multi-Band 6

case.bezel: DLC-coated stainless steel screw-back, mirror-polished caseback

identity.one_liner: Casio's Japan-made premium square: a stainless screw-back case with Tough Solar power and Multi-Band 6 radio sync, built to a tighter finish than the resin DW-5600.

narrative.story: The GW-5000U updates Casio's Japan-built metal square with a revised module (3495) that adds an LED backlight and an adjustable date format over the earlier GW-5000, while keeping the full stainless screw-back case, DLC coating, mirror-polished caseback, Tough Solar power, and Multi-Band 6 radio sync. It sits between the resin DW-5600 and the titanium MRG-B5000 as the metal-cased square built for daily wear rather than dress-watch presentation.
narrative.collector_notes: Made in Japan, unlike most G-Shock resin squares assembled elsewhere; collectors treat the screw-back stainless case and DLC caseback as the marker that separates it from cheaper metal-look squares.
